sources.title: Pastoralism

sources.title: Refuse disposal at a Bedul camp

sources.title: Pitching Camp

sources.title: Lakes of Ounianga
sources.note: UNESCO description of hyperarid groundwater-fed lakes inside the atlas polygon and their exceptional ecology.

sources.title: Ennedi cultural and natural landscape report
sources.note: UNESCO documentation of long pastoral histories, rock art, refuges, and modern landscape use in eastern Chad.

sources.title: Settlement history of Wadi Howar

sources.title: Understanding Medieval Trans-Saharan Trade

sources.note: Scholarly synthesis of learned medicine, local care, religious practice, and medical pluralism.
